definition: in a way that is against the law
description: A sunny city street lined with cafes and trees. A bright yellow sports car is parked up on the pavement, its front wheels blocking the walkway beside a pedestrian crossing. A police officer in a navy uniform and cap stands at the windscreen and puts a parking ticket under the wiper. People at the cafe tables turn to watch, a young woman in an orange top walks past, and a young man in a white linen shirt and trousers rushes out of the cafe with his arms raised in protest.

taps.phrase: to wave his arms in protest
taps.target: the man in the linen shirt

en.question: What is the police officer doing?

es.answer: Está poniendo una multa de aparcamiento.
phrases: agitar los brazos en señal de protesta
